title: cli.json
description: A repo's one gated CLI over its store (PLAN-routing-tree.md §14.8; the skeleton setup installs is `{store, cli, verbs: []}`): the store's file(s), the CLI that is the only way in, and the verbs it offers. `accessor` validates this file against this schema with checkslib/checkjson.py and enforces each `x-rules` id in checkslib/contract.py, then audits that nothing else in the repo names the store. One CLI per repo: a repo with two CLIs over two stores is an open decision (TODO.md).

store.description: The store: one path, or a list of paths or globs, relative to the repo root. Its file may be git-ignored (a database usually is).

cli.description: The executable that is the only way into the store, relative to the repo root.

verbs.description: The verbs the CLI offers; each must be one `<cli> help` lists. Empty in setup's skeleton.

not_verbs.description: Optional: every other command `<cli> help` lists, each with why a caller may not run it. When present, verbs and not_verbs together are exactly the help's commands (the harness's .claude/cli.json uses it).

_comment.description: Optional prose for the reader; no check reads it.

x-rules.paths-inside: `cli` and every store path are relative paths inside the repo: not absolute, no `..` segment
x-rules.verb-implemented: every verb is a command `<cli> help` lists (checkslib/helptext.py reads the help)
x-rules.unique: no store path twice, no verb twice
x-rules.not-verbs-exact: with not_verbs: no command is in both verbs and not_verbs, and verbs + not_verbs are exactly the commands `<cli> help` lists, both ways
